text:
Priya (CSM): Hey team — Acme is scheduled to go live next Tue. Need a one-page customer-facing runbook (bullet-style) covering cache priming, safe batching windows, streaming fallback, quick health checks, and a short renewal-risk signal checklist. Something the CSM can paste into a kickoff email.

Ava (CS Ops): I can draft. Keep it action-first and very short. :white_check_mark:

Liam (SRE): Quick SRE notes to include: interactive batch_window <= 20ms; throughput jobs ok at 50–200ms. Fallback to single-token streaming when queue_depth > 200. Include a tiny healthcheck curl.

Jorge (Solutions Eng): I'll add a minimal YAML snippet they can drop into infra repo.

Ava (CS Ops): DRAFT RUNBOOK (copy-paste friendly):

PRE-FLIGHT (48–72h before)
- Verify API keys & role scopes with the customer
- Run smoke: 10 warm requests to surface cold-starts
- Seed cache: upload top-20 prompt prefixes (customer to provide)
- Confirm model pin/version + quantization profile

GO-LIVE HOUR (first 60m)
- Interactive routes: max_wait_ms=20, max_tokens_per_batch=1024
- Background routes: max_wait_ms=150, max_tokens_per_batch=8192
- Enable prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts
- Start 15m warm pool: pre-init ~50 concurrent light requests

HEALTH CHECKS (every 5m)
- P95 latency < SLA threshold
- Error rate < 1%
- Token throughput within expected range
- If latency rises: reduce batch window or route to lower-capacity model

DEGRADATION & FALLBACK (automated)
- If queue_depth > 200 -> enable single-token streaming + lower max_wait_ms
- If OOM/GPU failure -> route to next-compatible quantized variant
- Notify: status channel + short customer message template

RENEWAL SIGNALS (early warning)
- Usage drop > 30% WoW after onboarding
- Repeated timeouts or quality regressions in support tickets
- No enablement engagement after 2 weeks
- Action: CSM outreach + dev sync if flagged

FEEDBACK (lightweight capture)
- Daily 3-question form: latency / accuracy / recommend (would/neutral/not)
- Automated eval: sample prompt set every 12h, post to shared dashboard
- If accuracy drops > 8% vs baseline -> auto-create ticket tagged renewal-risk

OWNERS & ESCALATION
- Tier 1: Priya (CSM) — customer comms
- Tier 2: Jorge (Solutions Eng) — config & infra
- Tier 3: Liam (SRE) — incidents & routing

OWNER TASKS (short)
- Priya: send runbook to customer + collect seed prompts by EOD Thu
- Jorge: add YAML snippet to repo + confirm model pin by Fri
- Liam: run 30m preflight at Mon 10:00am

Jorge (Solutions Eng): CONFIG SNIPPET (paste to repo)
```yaml
routes:
  - name: interactive
    max_wait_ms: 20
    max_tokens_per_batch: 1024
    caching: prefix
  - name: background
    max_wait_ms: 150
    max_tokens_per_batch: 8192
    caching: none
fallbacks:
  - condition: queue_depth > 200
    action: enable_streaming_single_token
  - condition: gpu_failure
    action: route_to: model-quant-v2
```

Liam (SRE): HEALTHCHECK (curl)
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"health-check","route":"interactive"}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
- Expect 200 and latency header within SLA

Priya (CSM): Love it. Add a one-line customer message template for outages?

Ava (CS Ops): Template: "We're seeing elevated latency; we're shifting traffic to a compatible variant and will update in 15m."

OnboardBot: Deployment notice: acme-infra staged to prod at 1705123460 — warm pool initialized. :rocket:

Priya (CSM): Perfect — I'll paste into the kickoff email and follow up after the first 24h. :raised_hands:
